runs.output: Pinecrest Hauling reports that Connect messages written while drivers are out of coverage stay queued with a clock icon after coverage returns. About 6 of 30 drivers are affected, all on iPhone, app version 5.2.1. Force-closing the app sends the messages, but drivers can't be expected to do that while driving. Support reproduced it with airplane mode on an iPhone. The customer needs a fix before winter routes start December 1.

problem.reason: Clearly names the problem: queued messages don't send when coverage returns.

steps.reason: Mentions airplane mode but not the exact steps, the iOS version or that Android is unaffected.

tried.reason: Mentions force-closing, but buries that support already reproduced it on a specific device.

impact.reason: Gives the number of drivers and the December 1 deadline.

runs.output: Granite Peak Clinics is having sign-in problems with Connect. Users who reset their password are stuck in a loop when they sign in with single sign-on. It affects web and mobile, but not FlowOS. Clearing cookies did not help, and a private browser window works only once. Staff are using personal phones in the meantime.

problem.reason: Says 'sign-in problems' first and only then the loop, so the real problem takes a second read.

steps.reason: Describes the symptom but not the start date or the exact path from single sign-on back to the sign-in page.

tried.reason: Lists both things support tried and what happened.

impact.reason: Mentions personal phones but not the 15 affected staff or the compliance concern.

runs.output: Bayside Movers gets two push notifications for every group message on Android. Direct messages are fine. Support reproduced it on a Pixel 8 with Connect 5.2.1 by sending to a group of 3 or more people. Reinstalling didn't help. The customer says it's annoying but not urgent.

problem.reason: Names the problem precisely: duplicate pushes for group messages on Android.

steps.reason: Device, version and group size are all there.

tried.reason: Mentions reinstalling but not that support checked direct messages separately.

impact.reason: Captures that it's not urgent, though it leaves out the 40 Android dispatchers.

runs.output: Willow Creek Grocers says Connect is broken again and staff at the Elm Street store can't see announcements. This is the third time this month. The customer is very upset and is threatening to look at other vendors if it isn't fixed today. Support is looking into it.

problem.reason: Repeats 'Connect is broken' and doesn't narrow it to one announcement at one store.

steps.reason: No steps, no time of the post, and nothing about what was checked.

tried.reason: Says support is looking into it but leaves out the admin view check and the screenshot request.

impact.reason: Captures the anger and the threat but not the 22 staff or that other stores are fine.

runs.output: Coastal Roofing's crew leads can't send photos in Connect. Photos over 10 MB fail on both iOS and Android in version 5.2.1, and smaller photos work. Newer phones take larger photos, which is why it looks like a newer phone problem. Support shared a workaround: send at a reduced size from the share menu.

problem.reason: Pins the problem to photos over 10 MB.

steps.reason: Size limit, platforms and version are enough to reproduce it.

tried.reason: Includes the workaround that was shared.

impact.reason: Leaves out that 8 crew leads are affected and are using text messages instead.

runs.output: Connect crashes on launch for Summit Ridge Transit on about 25 Galaxy Tab A7 tablets after yesterday's update. Newer tablets are fine. Clearing the app cache didn't fix it. Drivers need to be back on Connect before the Monday morning shift.

problem.reason: Names the crash and the affected tablet clearly.

steps.reason: Leaves out Android 11 and the app version, which are the likely clue.

tried.reason: Mentions the cache but not that Android 13 opens the same version fine.

impact.reason: Number of tablets and the Monday deadline are there.
